pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: The engagement should be structured with a fixed fee and milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: The project must free up $1.4M in working capital currently stuck in unbilled receivables.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital

success_criteria.statement: The operational improvements should save $320k by avoiding the need to hire additional dispatchers.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year

risks_unknowns.statement: There is disagreement on the approved budget cap for the Phase 1 engagement.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CFO Rita insists on a hard $300k cap, while VP Ops Sarah believed they had a $250k to $400k range.

pain_points.statement: The legacy Routemaster platform has severe technical debt, making feature development extremely slow and fragile.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Technical debt in Routemaster. We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

desired_state.statement: The company needs to decide whether to replace the legacy platform with SaaS or fix existing workflows.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I think this is a platform problem.
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus wants to replace the platform entirely with a SaaS product, while VP Ops Sarah wants to fix workflows on the existing platform.

success_criteria.statement: A majority of the workflow logic built in Phase 1 must be portable to a future platform.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the workflow issues have failed, raising skepticism about this project's viability.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual double-entry between the dispatch tool and Salesforce.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: The custom mobile app is highly unpopular with the contracted drivers.

desired_state.statement: The company wants to significantly reduce the time it takes to dispatch each load.
desired_state.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

success_criteria.statement: The invoicing process must return to an industry-standard Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
success_criteria.source_excerpt: return to five-day DSO from where we are now

risks_unknowns.statement: Any changes to the driver app must be carefully coordinated with upcoming ELD compliance updates.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: If we're going to touch the driver app, the ELD work has to be coordinated.

pain_points.statement: Key stakeholders are fundamentally misaligned on the root cause of the company's operational issues.
pain_points.source_excerpt: we don't agree on what the problem is.

desired_state.statement: The new workflow solutions must not interfere with the critical ELD compliance mandate.
desired_state.source_excerpt: whatever we build needs to not get in the way of the compliance work.

success_criteria.statement: The pilot must be in production by the end of Q3 to prevent budget reallocation.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a dispute over whether a Q3 deadline is realistic or if it should be pushed to Q4.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CFO Rita and VP Ops Sarah mandate a Q3 deadline to secure funding, but CTO Marcus believes Q4 is required and refuses to commit to Q3.

risks_unknowns.statement: Failure to meet the November ELD deadline could result in severe regulatory penalties.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.
